title: MedZen speech manifest record (A3)
description: One JSON object per line in manifest.jsonl. Every dataset, regardless of source, is normalised into this shape by its adapter.

duration_s.description: Whisper truncates beyond 30s. Floor 0.3s is the physical minimum for word-level domains (asr_words); the validator range check enforces 1.0s for all other domains.

sample_rate.description: Resample BEFORE anything touches the model

text_verbatim.description: As spoken. Never normalised into English.

text_normalized.description: Canonical form used for scoring and search

normalization_version.description: e.g. pidgin-norm-v2 — changing it invalidates cached scores

primary_language.description: Registry alias or ISO code; 'mixed' for code-switched

segments.description: Span-level code-switch annotation. A single 'mixed' label is insufficient for error analysis.

consent_id.description: Links to the consent registry. Deletion propagates from here.

dataset_release.description: Exact upstream release, so a result is reproducible

split_strategy.description: How train/test were separated, which determines WHICH leakage invariant applies. ASR corpora must generalise to unseen SPEAKERS -> speaker_disjoint. Parallel TTS corpora (many speakers reading one script) must generalise to unseen TEXT -> text_disjoint; speaker overlap is the point, not a leak. Near-duplicate text may never straddle splits under either strategy.

raw_filepath.description: REQUIRED. The original artifact as acquired, before resampling. Every curated object must be re-derivable and auditable from its source.

raw_checksum_sha256.description: REQUIRED. Checksum of the ORIGINAL bytes; audio_checksum_sha256 covers the curated 16 kHz WAV that is actually trained on.

license_tier.description: Commercial-safety tier (green-bucket 2026-08); physical isolation follows this field.
